purpose: Teach: オリックス/テレビ朝日/スズキ/男優/ソビエト/ケニア/司馬/ブルジョアジー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがオリックスの試合をご覧になった
lines.en: You know, when you were young, your father used to watch the Orix games.
lines.style: Soft, musing tone. Gaze turned inward, following a thread of old memory. Slow pace, gentle breath. The voice of someone speaking half to you, half to the past.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、テレビ朝日のニュースを毎晩観てらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you used to watch the news on Asahi every night, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing chuckle beneath the words. Affectionate correction wrapped in tenderness. Slight lift at the end — a gentle reminder that memory flows both ways.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがスズキの自転車に乗ってらした
lines.en: And when you were younger, your father rode that Suzuki bicycle everywhere.
lines.style: The same soft, threading quality as the first line. A pause before 'Suzuki' — reaching back for the detail. Quieter, more intimate. Still half-dreaming.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃の男優映画をご覧になってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you — you used to love watching those old films with the actors, remember, dear?
lines.style: Playful now, a light tease. Eyes sparkling. Her memory is sharper than his, and she knows it. The affection in 'dear' carries a small laugh.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがソビエト崩壊のニュースに驚かれた
lines.en: Your father was so surprised when he heard the Soviet Union had collapsed.
lines.style: Wondering, almost astonished in the remembering. A shift — this memory carries weight. Slower still. The voice of someone marveling at how much has changed.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ケニアコーヒーを取り寄せられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you — you had Kenyan coffee specially ordered, didn't you? Such fine taste.
lines.style: Proud admiration softening into gentle mockery. A tender jab at his refined habits. The lilt of someone who loved him for his particular ways.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが司馬遼太郎の大河ドラマを楽しまれた
lines.en: When you were young, your father loved those Shiba Ryotaro historical dramas so much.
lines.style: Deep nostalgia now, almost reverent. The slowest of all. Breath settling. The voice reaching further back into time, into something that shaped him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ブルジョアジー批判の本を読まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you were always reading those thick books criticizing the bourgeoisie, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Fond, knowing laughter in the voice. A final tender look back at who he was. The affection complete and unguarded. Trails off warmly, the conversation gently closing.
